title: Wild West Chronicles
description:
S03 E07 — Calamity Jane Saves the Day
Throughout Deadwood, Calamity Jane is known as a hot-tempered drunk; when a deadly smallpox outbreak spreads through town, Calamity Jane works tirelessly to save the lives of the infected citizens who treat her with such contempt.

title: Wild West Chronicles
description:
S03 E13 — The Four Dead in Five Seconds Gunfight
After two Mexican vaqueros cross the border in search of stolen cattle, they are gunned down by rustlers; the newly appointed marshal of El Paso, Texas, arrests local ranch hands for the murders, sparking one of the West's most infamous gunfights.

title: Into the Wild Frontier
description:
S01 E03 — Jim Beckwourth: War Chief of the Crow
In an epic tale of adventure, former slave Jim Beckwourth goes West to work as a trapper only to become a battle-hardened war chief of the Crow; when a conflict with mountain men leads to violence, he must choose between the two worlds he loves.

title: The Cowboy Way: Alabama
description:
S04 E03 — A New Chapter
The cowboys process hundreds of new cattle as part of their deal with a local rancher; Bubba and Kaley call in favors to get a new barn built; Booger and Jaclyn worry she may lose her job; Cody decides to write a book about cowboy values.

title: Maverick

S01 E06 — Stage West
A young widow tries to take possession of her late husband's silver mine.

title: Against a Crooked Sky
description: An old trapper (Richard Boone) helps a young man (Stewart Petersen) find his sister, abducted by Indians.

title: Elkhorn
description:
S02 E08 — War
When a ruthless Chicago cattle baron invades Medora with a legion of gunslingers, Theodore Roosevelt must join forces with his old adversary, the Marquis de Morés; together, they hatch a desperate plan to save their town from certain destruction.

title: Maverick
description:
S01 E25 — Black Fire
Bret investigates the murders of three people who stood to inherit money from an aging relative.

title: Prairie Fever
description: While transporting three women across the plains, a man (Kevin Sorbo) encounters an outlaw (Jamie Anne Allman) on the run from her partner (Lance Henriksen).

title: The Tall Tales of Jim Bridger
description:
S01 E04 — A Prince on the Prairie
While guiding a hunting expedition, Jim Bridger must deal with an arrogant foreign prince who is abusing his servant boy; the tables soon turn when it's the prince who needs rescuing, and his only hope is the long-suffering servant boy.

title: The Rifleman

title: Wild West Chronicles
description:
S04 E09 — Law Comes to No Man's Land
Marshal Chris Madsen helps newly appointed judge John Buford bring law and order to Oklahoma's Panhandle in an area known as No Man's Land; after escorting a wagon train of prisoners to Beaver City, they set up their first courthouse inside a saloon.

title: Wild West Chronicles
description:
S04 E12 — The Battle of Stone Corral
When bandits rob a train and gun down a pursuing marshal, they spark one of the largest manhunts in California history; after taking shelter behind the crumbling walls of Stone Corral, they make their final stand against a hail of gunfire.

title: Into the Wild Frontier
description:
S03 E01 — Anne Bailey: Horseback Heroine
After Anne Bailey's husband is killed by Native Americans, she defies the social norms of the frontier and becomes a horseback courier, risking her life to race through hostile territory delivering vital supplies to isolated forts and settlements.

title: Maverick
description:
S04 E26 — The Deadly Image
Bart is mistaken for a notorious outlaw and faces a deadly enemy.

title: The Big Trees
description: Corrupt Wisconsin lumberman Jim Fallon travels to Northern California at the dawn of the 20th century in order to gain control of a tract of redwood forest. Fallon's underhanded tactics stir resentment from everyone.

title: Elkhorn
description:
S02 E03 — Under Suspicion
While Theodore Roosevelt and his men help catch a horse thief, the town of Medora is thrown into turmoil when its enigmatic founder, the Marquis de Morés, is unexpectedly arrested and taken to Bismarck to stand trial for the murder of a rancher.

title: The Legend of 5 Mile Cave
description: In 1929 a mysterious stranger renting a room on a widow's farm shares tales of the Old West with her young son. As they bond, the boy realizes the man knows a little too much about a gold robbery, and his secret may save the farm.

title: Bonanza
description:
S02 E16 — The Courtship
Hoss falls prey to a beautiful woman with a gambling addiction and refuses to believe she's only interested in his money.

title: Bonanza
description:
S02 E17 — The Spitfire
Maud Hoad leads her revenge-seeking family against Joe, who was forced to shoot treacherous Jeb Hoad.

title: Doc West
description: Seeking revenge for a poker game gone bad, gunslinger Doc West finds himself in the local town jail. When a battle among the townspeople breaks out, he must choose sides.
